Introducing the world's first 100% decentralized matrix project programmed on an Ethereum smart contract called Frissage, where 100% of the income goes directly and transparently to the members of the project with zero risk. And it is extremely powerful as it ensures the project will keep running an there's zero risk of possibility of hacking into the smart contract or stopping the project. Unlike centralized crypto currency projects, the founders of Forsage never takes or stores a member's crypto currency, in any centralized location so it's completely secure. 100 percent of all aetherium payments are sent instantly and directly to the members of Forsage and stored in their personal aetherium wallets which they control the private keys. Each subsequent slot you purchase is 2 times the value of the previous one. and it generates twice the income as well. Each slot generates you income unlimited times with no expiration. For example The 0.1eth slot generates you 0.1eth over and over again. The 0.2eth slot generates you 0.2th again and again. annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes joining Forsage by making an initial Ethereum payment and purchasing progressively more valuable slots in exchange for claimed recurring income. It describes Ethereum payments flowing to participant wallets and an upline while asserting earnings of 1,000 ETH or more, linking the tiered participation structure to unusually large financial-return claims. The assessment is based on these promotional claims and payment mechanics rather than independently verified earnings, technical operation, or completed transactions.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central mechanism is income associated with purchased slots in X3 and X4 matrices, participant teams and uplines. The source explicitly links slot purchases to income and describes payments flowing to an upline; the supplied frames also show tiered participant diagrams and an identified upline.
